message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features an orchestra scene. In the foreground, a man with short black hair wearing a white tuxedo jacket and trousers is viewed from behind, acting as a conductor. His right arm is raised, holding a thin white baton, while his left hand rests on the rim of a large brass-colored bell of a trombone.

Around him, seven figures dressed in formal concert attire—including black tuxedos with bow ties and a red sleeveless dress with a pearl necklace—are depicted with their heads replaced by blue, bird-like silhouettes. These blue head-shapes have sharp, beak-like protrusions pointing to the left. The figures hold various instruments, including a violin and a trombone.

In the lower right, a large blue speech bubble contains black text starting with "ORKESTRA PENDENGUNG". Additional Indonesian text appears at the top: "MAIN BEKING IMPOR TEKSTIL ILEGAL" and "SENGKETA HUTAN ADAT KINIPAN". A sidebar includes the date "31 AGUSTUS - 6 SEPTEMBER 2020", a price, a barcode, and a QR code. The background consists of dark, indistinct shapes and the large, shadowed letters "TEMPO".
